portal_description:
NetworkManager is a system network service that manages network devices and connections, attempting to keep active network connectivity when available. Its capabilities include managing Ethernet, wireless, mobile broadband (WWAN), and PPPoE devices, as well as providing VPN integration with a variety of different VPN services.

Bug Fix(es):

* Routes in table different to main are not deleted on reapply [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-73011)

* Reapply on bridge port did not reset default-pvid [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-70697)

* [balance-slb] br-ex fails to activate after patch-ex-to-phy activation [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-78744)

* Connection autoactivation gets blocked after failing [rhel-9.4.z] (RHEL-78747)
